summary: Broadcasts an 8-byte status payload (aStatus) as a UDP datagram over a contiguous range of ports: iterates the port counter from a2 up to a3 stepping by a4, converts each port with htons, fills a sockaddr with the broadcast address, and calls sendto on the socket handle stored at a1+136. After the loop it calls AudioValueSetterCall(a1, 2) and records GetTickCount() at a1+140 before returning 0.

local_names.v4: port loop counter seeded from a2
local_names.v6: port converted to network byte order
local_names.to: sockaddr with family 2 (AF_INET) and broadcast address

operations.description: Initialize v4 = a2 as the port loop counter, set to.sa_family = 2 (AF_INET), and write the broadcast address -1 into the dword at to.sa_data+2 (255.255.255.255).
Iterate v4 over the port range while v4 <= a3, incrementing v4 by a4 each pass.
Convert the current port to network byte order: v6 = htons(v4).
Load the SOCKET handle v7 = *(DWORD*)(a1 + 136) and store v6 as the port word in to.sa_data.
Send the 8-byte status string aStatus to the broadcast address on the current port: sendto(v7, aStatus, 8, 0, &to, 16).
After the broadcast loop, notify the audio layer: AudioValueSetterCall(a1, 2).
Return 0 unconditionally as the completion status.
